note: TEST KEYS ONLY. Every private scalar below is derived from the key name as sha256('orch-f1-test-key|' + name) mod (n-1) + 1 and is published on purpose; the signatures are RFC 6979 (deterministic), so consumers verify the stored signature and never re-sign.

transition_cases.name: walk_compromised_learned_from_higher_n_bundle_alarm_only
transition_cases.note: learned_later_in_walk comes from a higher-n bundle judged after this one: it is not known_revocations here; the receiver commits this transition and raises an alarm

transition_cases.name: walk_compromised_learned_from_lower_n_bundle_refuses
transition_cases.note: learned from a lower-n bundle of the same walk, so held when this one is judged

transition_cases.name: walk_retired_known_before_sync_stays_refused_until_repaired
transition_cases.note: liveness cost: a genuine older transition by a device the receiver already knows retired stays refused until an owner pairs the receiver again

transition_cases.name: non_owner_revocation_held_ticket_restore_accepted
transition_cases.note: a ticket restore carries [] and cannot deliver a revocation; a non-owner revocation the receiver holds neither completes nor blocks it
